Legenda
━━ requisição / acesso a dados · ━━ interno ao monitoramento · ┅┅ imagem ECR · ┅┅ secrets · ┅┅ egress (NAT → IGW → Internet) · ┅┅ Terraform
Security Groups: Internet → ALB SG :80 · ALB SG → Frontend SG :80 · ALB SG → Backend SG :8000 · ALB SG → Monitoring SG :3000 · Backend SG → Application RDS SG :5432 · Monitoring SG → Monitoring RDS SG :5432
